summary: SDC Legal focuses on DIFC and ADGM matters with a visible WhatsApp button. The contact section is empty and parts of the site point to a staging address, which loses the clients who are ready to call.

findings.problem: The How to Reach Us section is empty, apart from blank lines. There is no booking button, and the only action is a floating WhatsApp button.
findings.cost: A client ready to hire a DIFC lawyer who does not use WhatsApp has no clear way to reach you and moves on.
findings.fix: A visible contact form and a Book a consultation button on every page.

findings.problem: The footer Main Services and Practice Area links point to a staging address (pink-wasp-856671.hostingersite.com), and DIFC Legal Hub and Guides in the menu link to #.
findings.cost: Clients who click a staging link land on an unfamiliar site and may think it is unsafe, and dead menu links lose your guides.
findings.fix: Every link on your own domain and a working menu.

findings.problem: The phone number has no country code (045686559), the WhatsApp link goes to a different number than the listed mobile, and the address reads Sheikh Zayad Road.
findings.cost: A client calling from abroad cannot dial the number, and a WhatsApp message to the wrong number is never answered.
findings.fix: One verified set of contact details, correctly formatted.

findings.problem: The FAQ heading (High Ranking) shows as an SEO label, the DIFC Legal Hub menu lists several items twice, and testimonials are generic with no named clients or results.
findings.cost: A visible SEO label and repeated menu items look unprofessional, and generic praise does not convince a corporate client.
findings.fix: A clean page, a tidy menu and named reviews or case outcomes.

redesign: A consultation first homepage with a visible contact form, a booking button and WhatsApp.
Practice area pages written to rank for searches like DIFC employment lawyer and DIFC court lawyer.
Proof beside every button: named reviews, case outcomes and your credentials.
